newsitem.title: CANADA: Gulf Canada to boost plant's NGL output.
newsitem.headline: Gulf Canada to boost plant's NGL output.

text.p: Gulf Canada Resources Ltd said on Wednesday that a recent Alberta regulatory decision will allow it to double natural gas liquids output at one of its gas plants in the province.

Gulf said it obtained a go-ahead from the Alberta Energy and Utilities Board to maximize efficiency and extend the life of its Strachan gas plant by processing a sidestream of up to 210 million cubic feet per day of gas from the NOVA Corp's NOVA Gas Transmission Ltd system.
Under the arrangement, Gulf would recover natural gas liquids such as propane, butane and pentane-plus, it said. No ethane would be extracted.

Gulf said it applied to the EUB to produce an additional 2,200 barrels a day (50 percent net to Gulf) of liquids, effectively doubling production at Strachan, located 15 km southwest of Rocky Mountain House, Alberta.
